args.text: Can you put together every open or recent ticket and feature request on Marrow Agrisupply and Marrow Fieldworks? Pull from our team channels and Moss's Central notes, and label each one by account. I need the list for the Marrow review on Thursday.

@Hollis Mbeki here is the Marrow list from #central-team and Moss's Central digests. I could not check live ticket status, so each item shows its latest date.

MARROW AGRISUPPLY
1. PD-4821: Eastbank receiving-door import. Door labels are E1/E2 in the file but 01/02 in the booking sheet; fix before any reimport to avoid duplicates. Last update: 9 Jun 2026.
2. Pine Crossing: appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift, so morning bookings can't be made. Shift template check and support reproduction were assigned to you. No ticket number in the channel. Last update: 9 Jun 2026.
3. New-store rollout blockers: Priyanka was collecting one receiving lead per store (names, shift times, blockers). That list isn't in the channel yet. Last update: 9 Jun 2026.
4. FR-882: custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for seasonal fertilizer sheds. Routed to the Q2 product backlog. Last update: Jan 2026 digest.
5. Central cheat sheet (undated): "Check door 4 msg" for the Central ag account. No ticket number attached.

MARROW FIELDWORKS
6. #4409: recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at Salina North (Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron during the 06:00 flatbed intake). Open as of the Jan 2026 digest.
7. #4412: minor driver SMS prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots. Open as of the Jan 2026 digest.

Notes: the Jan 2026 digest describes #4409 and #4412 as being on "Pree's dealer account" and says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. Please confirm those two tickets belong to Fieldworks. Nothing in these sources has finance figures. I found no other Marrow tickets in the channel or the Central notes.
